pick.name: Remote Control push notifications
pick.what: Phone push when Claude finishes or needs input
pick.why: First-party, works away from the desk
pick.free_limits: Requires a Claude plan (Pro/Max plans/Team/Enterprise) or API billing; counts against plan usage

best_free.name: Terminal bell / Notification hook
best_free.what: Terminal bell or a Notification hook; some terminals (e.g. Windows Terminal) have no default desktop notification, so set preferredNotifChannel to terminal_bell or use a hook

alts.name: Orca notifications
alts.what: Desktop alerts when an agent needs input
alts.why: Desktop alerts if you run Orca

alts.name: ntfy
alts.what: HTTP pub-sub push to phone or desktop, callable from hooks
alts.why: Free hosted ntfy.sh with no account; self-hostable
alts.free_limits: free at ntfy.sh without account; paid from $5/month

decision: Remote Control push covers away-from-desk alerts; add a terminal bell/Notification hook for desktop alerts. Orca adds desktop alerts if you use it. Extra relay services are rarely needed.

verify.note: Shallow check: no neutrality, pricing or licence defect found; not re-fetched.
